description: Defines classes and functions for bit buffer manipulation, including reading, writing, and formatting bit buffers with static and dynamic memory options.

classes.name: bit_buffer_base
classes.description: Base class providing core functionality for bit buffers, including size calculations and internal storage.

classes.name: bit_buffer_reader
classes.description: Provides read access to packed bits within a bit buffer.

classes.name: bit_buffer
classes.description: Represents a packed bit buffer with methods for insertion, extraction, and conversion to string formats.

classes.name: static_bit_buffer
classes.description: A fixed-size bit buffer using static memory allocation.

classes.name: dynamic_bit_buffer
classes.description: A resizable bit buffer using dynamic memory allocation.

methods.name: set_buffer
methods.description: Replaces internal data container and sets current size.

methods.name: from_bytes
methods.description: Creates a bit buffer or reader from a span of bytes.

methods.name: get_reader
methods.description: Returns a reader object for the bit buffer.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts bits into the buffer at a specified position.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts bits from the buffer starting at a specified position.

methods.name: get_byte
methods.description: Retrieves an entire byte from the buffer.

methods.name: set_byte
methods.description: Sets an entire byte in the buffer.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Creates a sub-buffer pointing to the first 'count' bits.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Creates a sub-buffer pointing to the last 'count' bits.

methods.name: to_bin_string
methods.description: Converts the buffer to a binary string.

methods.name: to_hex_string
methods.description: Converts the buffer to a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: get_buffer
methods.description: Returns the internal buffer view for advanced usage.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the static or dynamic buffer.
